in_sanskrit.name: Lad
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord, Master
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Lad एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Lad is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ladh' which means 'Lord, Master'. It is a strong and masculine name, often given to boys in Hindu communities. The name evokes images of power, courage, and strength.
